policies_read_2026_11_20.action_taken: The site's disclosure sentence was aligned to the first-person wording on 2026-11-20 (was 'we earn', now 'I earn'). Section 5 also states a violation of it is a material breach (section 6(a)).

policies_read_2026_11_20.price_rule_verbatim: Product prices and availability may vary from time to time. Because prices for and availability of Products that you have listed on your Site may change, your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.

policies_read_2026_11_20.action_taken: Confirmed the site's decision to withhold prices and ratings is required by (b), not a matter of taste. Also confirmed the misleading-claims rule that the 'Compare all five' CTA fix addresses.

findings_this_pass.finding: All five ASINs resolve to the products recorded in the register, with the exact listing titles matching on 2026-11-20.

Prices are observable on every live listing, but publishing them remains prohibited without an Amazon-served display or licensed API data (S-POL 2(b), updated 2026-04-14). The site therefore keeps publishing no prices. Q-27's proposed dated-snapshot rule is answered in the negative by the policy text itself.

Carousel prices and ratings on each listing belong to neighbouring ASINs, not the target. Three products (P1, P2, P3, P5) had a neighbouring price or rating that could easily be mistaken for their own. Recording the distinction explicitly prevents an inference error.

Operating Agreement section 5 prescribes the first-person disclosure sentence and makes a violation of section 5 a material breach via section 6(a). The site's wording was corrected to the prescribed form on 2026-11-20.

The 'Compare all five' call to action was a paid Amazon link pointing at P1's listing. Under the misleading-claims rule (S-POL 2(b)) that label did not match the destination. Corrected: it now links to compare.html.
